title: The Day the School Bus Went Crazy
description: A wild ride with a very unusual bus driver

fields.prompt: Pick something someone would yell when they are surprised.
Pick a part of the body.

template:
It was Monday morning, and {name} felt {adjective} while waiting for the school bus. But when the bus finally pulled up, something was very wrong. The driver was a giant {animal} wearing sunglasses!

"All aboard!" said the {animal}. "Next stop: {place}!"

{name} climbed the steps and sat down. The seats were made of squishy {food}, and every time the bus hit a bump, it went {noise}! Before anyone could say a word, the whole bus started {verb.ingTense} down the road at {number} miles per hour.

All the kids screamed, "{exclaim}" and threw {thing.plural} out the windows. A police car chased after them, but the {animal} just honked the horn and said, "Catch me if you can!"

The bus zoomed up a hill, flew off a ramp, and soared right over the school. {name} held on tight with both hands and one {bodyPart}. Down below, the principal looked up and dropped her coffee.

Finally, the bus landed in the school parking lot with a giant {noise}. The {animal} hopped out, tipped its hat, and said, "Sorry I'm late. I got lost on the way to {place}."

The teacher didn't even look up from her desk. "Take your seats," she said. "And {name}, please stop {verb.ingTense} in the hallway."

It was the best Monday ever.
